title: Nigerian Puff-Puff with Nutmeg
summary: A sticky batter of flour, sugar, instant yeast, nutmeg and warm vanilla water rises for 45 minutes, then tablespoons are fried at 165 °C for about 6 minutes until puffed and golden.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.text: Whisk the flour, sugar, yeast, nutmeg and salt.

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Stir in the warm vanilla water for about 5 minutes until thick, smooth and sticky.

steps.title: Rise
steps.text: Cover and leave in a warm place for about 45 minutes until doubled.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Drop in tablespoons of batter and fry about 6 minutes, turning, until golden all over.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drain and serve warm or at room temperature.

tips: Moderate oil lets the centres cook through before the outside darkens.
Dip the scoop in hot oil so the batter slides off cleanly.
Toss in cinnamon sugar for a sweeter treat.

Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: Best on the day. Keep airtight at room temperature for 1 day and warm in a 180 °C oven for 5 minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
